steps.title: Inspect Hello App Design
steps.description: Inspect Hello App layout structure and resources to formulate the interactive 3D upgrade.

steps.title: Establish 3D Neobrutalist Palette
steps.description: Select precise high-contrast volumetric colors, solid borders, and layered physical shadows.

steps.title: Design Tactile 3D Action Button
steps.description: Create button_3d.xml to display a physical layered action button which translates downwards upon pressing.

steps.title: Design 3D Layered Card Container
steps.description: Create card_3d_background.xml using offset layers to represent flat extruded solid 3D shadow blocks.

steps.title: Design 3D Layered Wisdom Card
steps.description: Create wisdom_3d_background.xml with deep solid rose shadows for an elegant thematic secondary box.

steps.title: Design Recessed 3D Input Style
steps.description: Create input_3d_background.xml with inset properties to represent flat hollowed-out card entries.

steps.title: Implement Math-Driven 3D Projection Canvas
steps.description: Build Cube3DView.java to calculate three-dimensional rotation matrices and perspective projection vectors inside native canvas operations.

steps.title: Integrate 3D elements in Layout Configuration
steps.description: Rewrite activity_main.xml to declare custom volumetric widgets, replace flat backgrounds, and restructure vertical weight distributions.

steps.title: Implement Continuous Physics Rotation Loop
steps.description: Integrate Handler rotation run loops in MainActivity.java to keep the 3D space rotating while idle.

steps.title: Inject Dynamic Programmatic 3D States
steps.description: Build runtime LayerDrawable generators inside MainActivity.java to style individual 3D state button options.

steps.title: Hook Touch Events and Gesture Transforms
steps.description: Configure touch event interceptors to let the user swipe across the 3D cube, instantly overriding autonomous rotation.

steps.title: Optimize Resource Release Cycles
steps.description: Ensure MainActivity removes any active handlers or callbacks during activity lifecycle destroy phase.

steps.title: Re-verify Android XML Namespaces
steps.description: Scan AndroidManifest.xml and activity_main.xml templates to confirm single correct schema attributes and absolute relative paths.

steps.title: Clean Up Legacy Layout Files
steps.description: Remove reference elements to older flat assets and unify the architectural theme.

steps.title: Building Hello App
steps.description: Compile, build and assemble Hello App using Gradle commands.
